scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run start --prefix client"
